conclusions: The physical contour degenerates to the doubled boundary A=B at u=0.
The weighted ratio t is absent at orders zero and one.
Its first coefficient is proportional to A-B and therefore vanishes on the limiting contour boundary.
After resolving A-B=u*xi, t enters one order later than the first exceptional collision equation.
The Cayley-Menger contour geometry alone does not select an exceptional t at the first weighted collision layer.
scope: This is an exact polynomial statement about the source contour boundary. It does not yet include the full measure current, its distributional boundary, or the coefficient comparison map.
entry_785_gate: The pullback is an algebraic initial-form calculation only. Cayley-Menger inequalities do not define a complex continued cycle along the Bunch-Davies weighted approach; path transport and monodromy must be supplied before interpreting it as a physical current.
